title: sync_hop.c: Potential division by zero if CONFIG_LICHEN_SYNC_HOP_SUPERFRAME_MS is 0
description: Line 48: Division by superframe_ms has no guard against zero. If CONFIG_LICHEN_SYNC_HOP_SUPERFRAME_MS is misconfigured to 0, this causes undefined behavior. However, this requires compile-time misconfiguration rather than runtime input, so it is an unlikely edge case.
